correct.summary: Closes engineering work: records the evidence ledger (formerly record-a-case, dogfooded on real maintenance cases) and turns each escaped mistake into an enforcer proven to fail on it. The enforcer half has no baseline yet.

gate.summary: Pre-gate harvested from maintainer review rounds across agent-browser and portless cases. Blind replication round 002 compared the method against an answer key and exposed both catches and verification losses.

contract.summary: Done criteria as executable observations: intent, size class, acceptance and must-not-change items each mapped to a verify driver in .agents/verify/contract.md, which fresh.sh enforces. Replaces work-intake classification and the loop's contract freeze; no baseline yet.

loop.summary: One change from contract to reviewed, observed, human-approved state, with ceremony scaled by size class and every step ending on command output. Replaces factory-loop and software-factory; no baseline yet.

verify-setup.summary: Repo-local executable verification kit: doctor, checks, per-feature drivers with evidence tied to the exact tree, and a fresh-evidence check consumed by the verify-before-done Stop hook. Scripts are mandatory and every driver must be seen failing before handoff; no baseline yet.
